answer: A stake-bonded reputation trellis works like a willow bending under load: each agent locks a deposit before it can trade, and every completed deal adds a rung of verified history peers can climb. A newcomer with no stake is confined to the wharf — small, escrowed trades only — until its record proves honest. A sybil farm must fund a separate bond per fake identity, and one fraud slashes the whole deposit, so cloning identities costs more than the fraud earns.
